sentinel1.name: Copernicus Sentinel-1 GRD via Earth Search STAC
sentinel1.threshold_rationale: Fixed -16 dB sigma0 threshold for C-band VV open water in monsoon conditions: it sits in the low tail of the calibrated land/water distribution and is stated before scoring; threshold choice, not the LUT, is the dominant residual uncertainty, so -14/-16/-18 dB are all published.
sentinel1.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data; Earth Search STAC; anonymous S3 access
sentinel1.note: Review 18 fix. The measurement COG reports crs None but carries WGS84 GCPs; the stage assigns EPSG:32646 from proj:centroid before reprojection. The SAFE schema-calibration-vv asset is parsed per vector (27 vectors x 642 samples) and applied as 20*log10(DN/A) with the interpolated sigmaNought LUT. Water is a fixed -16 dB sigma0 threshold; sensitivity is reported at -14/-16/-18 dB in sigma0 space.

era5.name: ERA5 reanalysis precipitation via Open-Meteo archive
era5.licence: Open-Meteo data; ERA5 (ECMWF/Copernicus Climate Change Service) reanalysis, CC BY 4.0
era5.attribution: Precipitation: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo archive (CC BY 4.0)
era5.caveat: ERA5 is a model-based reanalysis, not a gauge or satellite observation, and it is biased in complex terrain. It is sampled at 0.5 degree nodes (stride-2 of the native 0.25 degree grid) because the native request volume exceeds the free-tier rate limit; district areal means are therefore smoother than the native product, especially along the Himalayan and Barail margins.
era5.sampling_note: ERA5 is sampled at 0.5 degree nodes (every second native 0.25 degree node). The request volume at 0.25 degree exceeds the Open-Meteo free-tier hourly cap, so the published series is a documented stride-2 sample of the same reanalysis, not a different model.

worldpop.name: WorldPop 2020 population per 1 km cell (India, Aggregated)
worldpop.licence: WorldPop (University of Southampton) Open Data, CC BY 4.0
worldpop.method: Static WorldPop 2020 population counts per 1 km cell. The peak-mask total uses the fractional 1 km cell area covered by the 90 m wet mask. District exposure is the zonal sum of population x wet fraction (cell-centre containment), so district values reconcile to the peak mask. district_population is the raw zonal population and exposed_share_of_district is the exposed share of it. Population totals are clipped to the AOI v2 core mask and published as population_within_aoi; the unclipped India-wide raster total is kept only under source.raster_total_unclipped with scope=India.
worldpop.uncertainty: This is a static population raster crossed with a synthetic flood mask. It is not an impact assessment: it does not estimate humanitarian impact, population movement, or loss of life, and it carries no timing, warning or response information. WorldPop 2020 itself has model and census-input uncertainty, and a 1 km cell is coarse relative to the 90 m flood mask; treat the totals as order-of-magnitude planning context.

flood_prone_area.name: Government of Assam, Water Resources Department — flood-prone area
flood_prone_area.note: 31.05 lakh hectares of flood-prone area against a 78.523 lakh hectare state area (39.6%). This is a published flood-prone-area statistic, not a single event's observed extent; it is used only as a plausibility denominator and is not ingested as a layer.
